title: The Parable of the Talents
description: A master entrusts his servants with talents before he goes away. Two manage them well and double the amount, and are rewarded by their master. The third buries his talent in the ground out of fear and is punished as a worthless servant.

versions.title: The Parable of the Talents

versions.reason: [major] references: Luke 19:11-27 is the parable of the minas, not the talents. Although they are similar, they are traditionally regarded as two different parables with distinct details (talents vs. minas, different numbers of servants, different context). It should be removed from this story.
